follow_up.answers_question: Would tripling trastuzumab's half-life maintain HER2 occupancy longer than improving its binding affinity tenfold?
follow_up.answer: Tripling trastuzumab's half-life keeps HER2 occupancy above the 95% threshold longer than improving binding affinity tenfold, because the half-life scenario remains above threshold at the end of the 180-day window while the affinity scenario falls below threshold within the window.
implications: Tripling half-life keeps occupancy above the 95% threshold for the full 180-day horizon, whereas tenfold stronger affinity falls below threshold before the horizon ends.
